'''Soboll Command Center''' was a [[Thaereian military]] base located in the [[platform city]] of [[Soboll]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==History==
The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Mub Tyeb]] was hired by the Thaereians to maintain the security systems in the base. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Thaereians withdrew all their land forces on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] to [[Soboll]] and the [[Heroes of Cularin]] were sent there to capture the commander of their forces there, [[Kurth San]]. They rendezvoused with Tyeb and he created a loophole in the security systems that allowed the heroes to enter the base, where they confronted San.
